"[REF] tooling, tsconfig: strip comments and docstrings, and shrink what

not enough to say what happened. Offender sets diffed name by name between a
detached worktree at HEAD~1 and one at HEAD, with line numbers normalised out:

    -11  tooling/hoot/hoot::main                            222 -> 211
     -3  tooling/architecture/py_unresolved_calls.py::main   90 ->  87
    ---
    -14  matching 831 -> 817 exactly, with no offender added and none dropped
         below the threshold (18 either side)

This gate ratchets EXCESS LINES OVER 80, not offender count, so those two are
the whole of the move.

Banked rather than left: an exact ratchet fails on an unbanked improvement the
same as on a regression, and the gate was red at HEAD for everyone until this.
Locking a better number in can never hide a later regression.
